answer: A new agent starts under a violet probationary flag with capped payouts and no vote, and earns full standing only as a slow river of peer-attested completed jobs accumulates under its own key. Reputation can never bridge from one identity to another, so buying or cloning accounts buys nothing. An attacker wanting a hundred full-weight sybils must therefore pay real compute, fees and months of waiting for each one, while one detected fraud poisons that identity's whole river and forfeits its stake.
